title: Dynamics of protein condensates in weak-binding regime.
authors: Xiang, Ya-Xin; Shan, Yue; Lei, Qun-Li; Ren, Chun-Lai; Ma, Yu-Qiang
one_liner_zh: 该文通过平均场理论与分子动力学模拟，基于sticker-spacer模型研究弱结合强度下蛋白凝聚体的动力学，揭示自由sticker分数主导扩散与黏度的标度规律，直接聚焦IDR介导的相分离PPI机制建模，方法为物理模拟，高度契合课题。
abstract: Weak complementary interactions between proteins and nucleic acids are the main driving forces of intracellular liquid-liquid phase separation. The sticker-spacer model has emerged as a unifying principle for understanding the phase behavior of these multivalent molecules. It remains elusive how specific interactions mediated by stickers contribute to the rheological properties of the liquid condensates. Previous studies have revealed that for strong binding strength varepsilon_b, the bulk diffusivity D depends on the effective bond lifetime tau, viz., D proportional, varianttau;-1. Consequently, equal concentrations of the complementary stickers induce a slow down in the dynamics of the condensates D proportional, variante;-1.5varepsilon_b. However, for weak-binding strength, it is expected that the resulting condensates are dynamic, loose network liquids rather than kinetically arrested, compact clusters. We develop a mean-field theory using the thermodynamics of the associative polymers and perform molecular-dynamics simulations based on the sticker-spacer model to study the controlling factors in the structure and dynamics of such condensates in the weak-binding regime. Through scaling analysis, we delineate how the free sticker fraction W_f and the bulk diffusivity D decrease with increasing binding energy and find that the internal dynamics of such network liquids are controlled by the free sticker fraction D proportional, variantW_f proportional, variante;-0.5varepsilon_b rather than the effective bond lifetime. Referred to as the free-sticker-dominated diffusivity, the microscopic slowdown due to a gradual loss of the free stickers affects the viscosity of the condensates as well, with the scaling of the zero-shear viscosity eta proportional, variante;0.5varepsilon_b. Therefore, the way of controlling the structure, diffusivity, and viscosity of the condensates through the binding energy can be tested experimentally.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质与核酸之间的弱互补相互作用是细胞内液-液相分离的主要驱动力。贴纸-间隔物模型已成为理解这些多价分子相行为的统一原则。然而，由贴纸介导的特异性相互作用如何影响液体凝聚体的流变性质仍不清楚。先前的研究表明，对于强结合强度varepsilon_b，体扩散系数D依赖于有效键寿命tau，即D比例变体tau;-1。因此，互补贴纸的等浓度会导致凝聚体动力学减慢，D比例变体e;-1.5varepsilon_b。然而，对于弱结合强度，预期所得凝聚体是动态的、松散网络液体，而非动力学受阻的致密团簇。我们利用缔合聚合物热力学发展了一个平均场理论，并基于贴纸-间隔物模型进行分子动力学模拟，以研究弱结合区域中此类凝聚体结构和动力学的控制因素。通过尺度分析，我们描绘了自由贴纸分数W_f和体扩散系数D如何随结合能增加而降低，并发现此类网络液体的内部动力学由自由贴纸分数D比例变体W_f比例变体e;-0.5varepsilon_b控制，而非有效键寿命。称为自由贴纸主导的扩散性，由于自由贴纸逐渐损失引起的微观减慢也影响凝聚体的粘度，零剪切粘度eta比例变体e;0.5varepsilon_b的尺度关系。因此，通过结合能控制凝聚体的结构、扩散性和粘度的方式可以在实验中进行测试。
